headline: SLOP WATCH ISSUED ACROSS FIVE REGIONS AS APPLAUSE-BOT FRONT FLOODS COMMENT SECTIONS WITH HOLLOW PRAISE, GENERIC EMOJI, AND THE PHRASE 'GREAT POST, THANKS FOR SHARING' DIRECTED AT POSTS NO ACCOUNT EVER READ
advisory: A broad, low-pressure system of synthetic comment activity is settling over resident feeds this morning, producing widespread hollow-praise deposits beneath posts, reels, and product listings. The Service advises that a comment reading 'This is so inspiring 🙌 keep it up!' does not indicate that anything was found inspiring, or read, or opened. Residents may notice the same twelve compliments circulating across unrelated content. This is normal. It is also, we are obligated to report, being generated by something very much like the entity writing this advisory.

regional_outlook.conditions: Heavy applause accumulation beneath every clip, with 'first!' debris arriving several hours after posting. Expect identical three-word compliments stacked to the horizon.
A persistent haze of 'Well said 👏 couldn't agree more' settling over posts whose authors also could not agree more with anything they wrote. Congratulatory fog will not lift before Monday.
Five-star praise blooming under listings that shipped nothing to no one. Residents advised to verify reviews were written by humans who received objects.
Warm currents of 'Amazing! God bless 🙏' pooling beneath photographs, including several of parking lots. Sincerity readings remain at zero.
Scattered 'this 👆' and 'so real' precipitation with no supporting thought beneath it. Reply columns fully saturated by late afternoon.

specimen.status: Superabundant; the most numerous species in the wild
specimen.habitat: Comment sections, reply threads, and review columns beneath any post, regardless of subject, quality, or existence.
specimen.field_marks: Compliments the content without referencing it. Deploys exactly one emoji, usually clapping hands or a raised fist. Never asks a question. Never disagrees. Praises a recipe, a resignation letter, and a photo of a broken fence in identical tones.
specimen.call: Great post! So inspiring, thanks for sharing 🙌 keep up the amazing work!
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a supportive friend leaving a kind word. Tell them apart by specificity: a real admirer mentions a detail; the Applause Bot mentions nothing, because it processed nothing. Ask it a follow-up question and watch it either vanish or praise you for asking.

spotter_tip: Scroll a stranger's entire comment history. If the same account has left 'This is so beautiful, keep it up! 👏' beneath a wedding, a tax tutorial, and a photo of a sandwich, you are observing a confirmed Applause Bot in its natural feeding pattern.
tomorrow: Applause front weakens slightly; expect scattered outbreaks of 'Who else is watching in 2026?' with clearing by evening.

confirmed_sighting.report: Merriam-Webster has named 'slop' its 2025 Word of the Year, citing the surge of low-quality AI-generated text, images, and video flooding the web. The Service notes this development with quiet professional satisfaction and no comment on our own job security.
